name: acc-firewall_updater
onCreateCommand: for d in /home/vscode/venv; do mkdir -p "$d"; if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$d"; else chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$d" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done
postCreateCommand: python -m venv /home/vscode/venv && /home/vscode/venv/bin/python -m pip install -U pip setuptools wheel build && /home/vscode/venv/bin/pip install flake8 pytest && /home/vscode/venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && /home/vscode/venv/bin/pip install -e .
